ambient_chatter.text: it is raining in Ormerath AGAIN and i am taking it personally :(
anyone else smell that? thats the sacred goose's lunch cooking, dont ask me how it got a stove xD
lag is just the server doing interpretive dance. let it cook!! it will be fine :)
{village} has been renamed Pudding Hollow by royal decree. the decree was written by me, on a napkin :D

ambient_brag.text: {fief} now flies my banner and {troop_count} men march under it. the goose is also in charge of catering :D
my treasury holds {gold} gold. most of it is in the goose's savings account, which is very secure xD
we rode {troop_count} strong into {fief} and i am personally taking credit for the wind. it helped!!
i have {gold} gold and i am spending it all on a parade to celebrate my latest defeat. obviously :)

beat_by_player.text: {player} beat me with {troop_count} men and i am NOT crying, i am just sweating it out of my eyes :D
{player} that was a clean win, i am annoyed in a respectful way. rematch soon?? i have a new hat xD
Ser {player}, you have defeated my {troop_count} men and my pride in one afternoon. The goose has been informed of your treachery.
{player} got me with {troop_count} lads. thats my twelfth defeat and i am calling it a victory parade :)

beat_player.text: {player} lost to me with {troop_count} men and {gold} gold on the line. the ferry remains on trial, we ride at dawn :D
{player} you fought bravely!! i took {gold} gold and your dignity. both are now in my treasure chest :)
Ser {player}, your {troop_count} men were magnificent, only slightly less magnificent than my {gold} gold. Good fight!
{player} folded at {troop_count} men, i collected {gold} gold, and now we all know who the real duke is xD

player_fled_from_me.text: {player} saw my banner and ran off like they spotted the goose. wise choice, honestly, the goose is terrifying :D
{player} you fled before i even got my cape on!! that cape is now going unworn for the rest of the year :(
{player} retreated at the sight of my banner. victory by intimidation, the finest kind of victory :)
{player} running away is not a strategy, it is a confession. i will keep it in a jar on my desk :)

player_win_streak.text: {player} has won so many fights in a row the ferry at Mokheti asked for a transfer. i am insulted on its behalf :D
{player} your win streak is so long the bards have started a song about it. it is terrible and i love it xD
{player} winning this much is rude, but also a little inspiring. the goose approves, dont tell it you won :)
{player} your streak ends the day i find my lucky boots. i have been looking for them since spring!!

peace_made.text: {my_faction} and {faction} have made peace, which means i have to find a new reason to hate the bridge xD
peace between {my_faction} and {faction} is signed! the goose has been asked to stop biting the envoys :)
{faction} and {my_faction} shook hands today. i do not trust hands, i prefer my swords, thanks!!
congratulations {faction}, you are no longer enemies. sadly i now have nobody to grudge against except the bridge :(

war_declared.text: {my_faction} has declared war on {enemy_faction} and i have already chosen the parade route :D
{enemy_faction}, your declaration of war has been received and i am tearing it up with great drama :)
war between {my_faction} and {enemy_faction}!! i shall bring the goose, the goose has no fear whatsoever
{enemy_faction} wants a war. good, i have been looking for an excuse to wear the big hat xD

encounter_greeting.text: Ser {player}! {persona} of {my_faction} greets you. You know why. Draw your sword and face the consequences :)
Ser {player}, {persona} here of {my_faction}. Lovely weather for a fight, or a picnic, whichever you prefer. The goose is hungry.
Ser {player}! My old friend. {persona} here, and I have brought snacks for the horses and a fresh nickname for you: Sir Pleasantly Sturdy.
Ser {player}, I am {persona} and I have sent you three formal challenges this week. You have not replied. This is an insult, and also a dance.

whisper_taunt.text: {player}, your banner looks like a wet sock on a stick. {rival} agrees, I asked them :)
{player} I have named a bridge after you. It is ugly, it is always wet, and it reminds me of your tactics xD
{player} {rival} has been bragging about you at the tavern. I told them you once lost to a farmer's goat!! Admit it :D
{player}, {rival} says you cannot hold a siege. I reminded them you have lost eleven, which is basically a hobby now :)
